metadata.description: Anime and manga recommendations built from your own taste.

home.tagline: Your next favourite anime or manga, picked from what you actually loved.

footer.tagline: Anime and manga picks built from your own taste.

mascot.search: Miraiko searching with a magnifying glass

signIn.title: Log in
signIn.heading: Your next favourite is one click away.
signIn.tabsLabel: Log in or create an account
signIn.checkInboxText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish signing in. The link expires in 24 hours.
signIn.legal: By continuing you accept the Terms and the Privacy policy.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email of your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentText: If an account exists for {email}, you'll get a link to reset your password. It works once and expires in 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.heading: New password
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Links work once and only for 1 hour.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed and every device has been signed out.
resetPassword.logInAgain: Log in with your new password

account.title: My account
account.newPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.resetLinkSent: Reset link sent to {email}. It works once and expires in 1 hour.

aniList.heading: AniList
aniList.linked: Your AniList account is linked. Miraiko reads and updates your list there.
aniList.notLinked: No AniList account linked: Miraiko can't recommend anything yet.
aniList.unlinkHint: Miraiko will stop reading your list. Nothing is deleted on AniList.
aniList.unlinkError: Couldn't unlink AniList. If you signed in more than a day ago, log out, log in again and retry.

authErrors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
authErrors.accountExists: An account already exists with this email. Log in instead.
authErrors.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least {min} characters.
authErrors.passwordTooLong: Your password is too long ({max} characters maximum).
authErrors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
authErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

emails.resetIntro: Someone asked to reset the password of your Miraiko account. Choose a new password here:
emails.resetOutro: This link works once and expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.
emails.changedIntro: The password of your Miraiko account was just reset, and every device was signed out.
emails.changedOutro: If it wasn't you, reset your password again right away from the "Forgot your password?" link on the log in page.
emails.verifyIntro: Confirm your email to finish creating your Miraiko account:
emails.verifyOutro: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't sign up, you can ignore this email.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: Every Miraiko component in one place, built from the Figma file “Miraiko — Maquette finale”.
designSystem.bodySample: Zen Kaku Gothic New — body text for descriptions and reviews.
designSystem.holoHint: Hover a card, or reach it with the Tab key.

onboarding.title: Link your AniList account
onboarding.heading: Link your AniList account
onboarding.intro: Miraiko reads your AniList list to find your next favourite. Your list stays on AniList: when you update a title here, it is saved there.
onboarding.why: Miraiko only works with an AniList account. It never asks for your AniList password: you sign in on AniList's own site.
onboarding.noAccount: No AniList account yet? <link>Create one for free</link>, then come back here.

errors.alreadyLinked: This AniList account is already linked to another Miraiko account.
errors.cancelled: The link was cancelled on AniList. You can try again.
errors.unknown: AniList didn't answer as expected. Please try again in a moment.

browse.title: Browse
browse.heading: Browse
browse.intro: Search every anime and manga on AniList. Hover a card: the page takes its colours.
browse.noResults: Nothing found for “{query}”. Check the spelling, or try the Japanese title.
browse.rateLimited: AniList is a bit busy right now. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
browse.unavailable: AniList is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
